Class TaskQueue

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<Runnable>
java.util.AbstractQueue<Runnable>
java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue<Runnable>
org.apache.tomcat.util.threads.TaskQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Iterable<Runnable>, Collection<Runnable>, BlockingQueue<Runnable>, Queue<Runnable>, RetryableQueue<Runnable>
public class TaskQueue extends LinkedBlockingQueue<Runnable> implements RetryableQueue<Runnable>
As task queue specifically designed to run with a thread pool executor. The task queue is optimised to properly utilize threads within a thread pool executor. If you use a normal queue, the executor will spawn threads when there are idle threads and you won't be able to force items onto the queue itself.
